title: A Composite Epigenetic Biomarker of FOXP3/TIGIT Correlates With Regulatory T Cell Numbers in Cord Blood and Is Associated With Subsequent Food Allergy.
authors: Nguyen, Viet Hong; O'Hely, Martin; Collier, Fiona; Sominsky, Luba; Dhar, Poshmaal; Molloy, John; Ponsonby, Anne-Louise; Tang, Mimi L K; Sly, Peter; Saffery, Richard; Novakovic, Boris; Vuillermin, Peter
journal: Clinical and experimental allergy : journal of the British Society for Allergy and Clinical Immunology
one_liner_zh: 该文利用DNA甲基化表观遗传标记预测调节性T细胞比例并关联食物过敏，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Flow cytometry studies have reported an association between lower regulatory T cells (Treg) in cord blood and subsequent food allergy. Flow cytometry, however, is a resource-intensive technique. We therefore aimed to develop an epigenetic biomarker (nTreg(epi)) that correlates with the proportion of naive regulatory T cells (nTreg) in cord blood white cells (CBWCs) measured by flow cytometry. We then investigated the association between nTreg(epi) and subsequent food allergy. METHODS: The Barwon Infant Study (BIS) is a prebirth cohort study (n = 1074 infants). Illumina Infinium MethylationEPIC v1.0 BeadChips were used to assess DNA methylation in cord whole blood (n = 936). In a subgroup, flow cytometry was used to measure the proportion of nTregs (CD4 + CD45RA + FOXP3+) in CBWCs (n = 450). In a training set (n = 338), we assessed the correlation between methylation at 78 probes in the FOXP3 and TIGIT genes and the proportion of nTregs in CBWCs. LASSO regression was then used to develop a linear methylation predictor of nTregs as a proportion of CBWCs, denoted 'nTreg(epi)', which was then tested in a validation set (n = 112). The association between nTreg(epi) and subsequent IgE-mediated food allergy was evaluated using logistic regression. RESULTS: Methylation levels of 23/78 sites in FOXP3 and TIGIT were associated with the proportion of nTregs in CBWCs (q < 0.05 for each). LASSO regression of methylation levels for these 21 probes was used to derive a linear predictor (nTreg(epi)) which correlated with the log proportion of nTregs in the validation set (R(2) = 0.22, p < 0.001). In the complete cohort with relevant data available (n = 693), a higher nTreg(epi) was associated with decreased odds of food allergy (odds ratio 0.65 (95% CI 0.48-0.88, p = 0.005)). CONCLUSIONS: A composite epigenetic biomarker in cord whole blood correlates with the proportion of nTreg in CBWCs and is strongly associated with the absence of subsequent food allergy.
abstract_zh: 背景：流式细胞术研究已报道脐带血中较低水平的调节性T细胞（Treg）与后续食物过敏之间存在关联。然而，流式细胞术是一种资源密集型技术。因此，我们旨在开发一种表观遗传生物标志物（nTreg(epi)），该标志物与通过流式细胞术测量的脐带血白细胞（CBWCs）中初始调节性T细胞（nTreg）的比例相关。随后，我们研究了nTreg(epi)与后续食物过敏之间的关联。方法：Barwon婴儿研究（BIS）是一项出生前队列研究（n = 1074名婴儿）。使用Illumina Infinium MethylationEPIC v1.0 BeadChips评估脐带全血中的DNA甲基化（n = 936）。在一个亚组中，使用流式细胞术测量CBWCs中nTregs（CD4 + CD45RA + FOXP3+）的比例（n = 450）。在训练集（n = 338）中，我们评估了FOXP3和TIGIT基因中78个探针的甲基化与CBWCs中nTregs比例之间的相关性。随后，使用LASSO回归开发了一个线性甲基化预测因子，用于预测nTregs占CBWCs的比例，记为“nTreg(epi)”，并在验证集（n = 112）中进行测试。使用逻辑回归评估nTreg(epi)与后续IgE介导的食物过敏之间的关联。结果：FOXP3和TIGIT中23/78个位点的甲基化水平与CBWCs中nTregs的比例相关（每个q < 0.05）。使用这21个探针的甲基化水平进行LASSO回归，得出一个线性预测因子（nTreg(epi)），该因子与验证集中nTregs的对数比例相关（R(2) = 0.22，p < 0.001）。在具有相关数据的完整队列中（n = 693），较高的nTreg(epi)与食物过敏几率降低相关（比值比0.65（95% CI 0.48-0.88，p = 0.005））。结论：脐带全血中的复合表观遗传生物标志物与CBWCs中nTreg的比例相关，并与后续食物过敏的缺失密切相关。
